description: Backlog of quantitative spec-vs-reality benchmark topics for Batch 2 (Articles 11-25) and Batch 3 (Articles 26-40).
workflow: 2. Run `python scripts/miner.py --all-configured` to harvest HN / GitHub / Reddit numerical logs into `data/candidates/`.
3. Generate structured dataset JSON in `content/articles/<slug>.json` adhering to `validate_article` schema.
4. Run `python scripts/build_site.py && python scripts/validate_site.py` to compile HTML + CSV and pass all security/legal/A11y checks.
5. Push to `main` to trigger automatic Cloudflare Pages deployment via `.github/workflows/ci-quality-gate.yml`.
